senses.gloss: to be round, smooth (cmp. Arab. tafailam pinguis fuit); only in part. Pu. מְפוּלָּם smooth, viscous.—Pl. מְפוּלָּמִין, מְפוּלָּמוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 54a:8">Zeb. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אבנים מפ׳</he> smooth stones (fresh from the ground).

<cite ref="Chagigah 12a:7">Ḥag. 12ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>בהו</he> <cite ref="Genesis 1:2">Gen. I, 2</cite>) <he>אלו אבנים המפ׳ וכ׳</he> that means the smooth (chaotic) stones which are sunk in the deep &c. (with ref. to <he>אבני בהו</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 34:11">Is. XXXIV, 11</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 4:4">Yalk. Gen. 4</cite>.—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 28:3">Targ. Job XXVIII, 3</cite> <he>אבנין מפולמין וכ׳</he> (Ms. ed. Wil. <he>מְפוּלָּמָן</he>) smooth (chaotic) stones out of which darkness proceeds (h. text <he>אבן אפל</he>).
